title: Two-register manual
summary: Separate explanation and document control from operational demonstrations while linking them through one navigation structure.

guidelines: Document cover and identity → contents → numbered specification sections.
Use prose, tables and callouts for the explanatory register.
Embed operational examples in a distinct terminal register, clearly labeled as examples or live instruments.
Separate current specification, research, superseded material and future proposals in appendices.
adaptations: Project-specific subject matter omitted; method/structure/standard generalized from the cited source.
